name: dependency-update-triage
description: Assess a single dependency update before adopting it, across three prongs: required code changes, enabled improvements, and latent-bug reach from an upstream fix.

interface.shortDescription: Assess a dependency update before adopting it.
interface.longDescription: Adds a read-only skill that assesses one dependency update: whether it requires code changes, what improvements (including testability) it enables, and whether a bug it fixes may still affect the application. Ecosystem and release-notes location are detected from the host project at runtime.
defaultPrompt: Should we upgrade this package to the new version?
Assess this dependency update PR before I merge it.
What does this dependency bump change for us?
